subject: Coord: SE deep-dive + procurement/security availability
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Erin Walker <erin.walker@acmeiq.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Nov 2027 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Coord: SE deep-dive + procurement/security availability

Hi Erin —

Thanks again for taking the call last week. Per our conversation, AcmeIQ wants a 60–75 minute technical deep-dive with Solutions Engineering to cover: architecture fit, data handling (VPC options), and a short Q&A for your security/procurement folks.

Quick asks from our side:
- Can you confirm who from security/procurement needs to be present? (name + email)
- Any hard blackout windows we should avoid?
- Preferred timezone for scheduling (I saw PST and ET mentioned)

Ben (SE) and Dylan (platform) are looped — Ben will lead the demo. We can run two shorter sections: 40 min technical walkthrough + 20–30 min security/procurement-focused Q&A.

I attached a short proposed agenda and three candidate windows (IANA attached ICS):
• Tue 11/23 10:00–11:15 PT
• Wed 11/24 13:00–14:15 PT
• Mon 11/29 09:30–10:45 PT

If none of those work, share 2–3 slots and we’ll adapt.

Best,
Ava Chen
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198

Attachments: proposed-calendar-options.ics, acmeiq-procurement-checklist.xlsx

Thanks Ava —

Quick notes from our side:
- I'll be there (Erin Walker, Product Lead). Copying procurement and Samir (our security lead).
- Procurement: procurement@acmeiq.com will attend initial Q&A and confirm PO timeline.
- Security: Samir Patel (samir.patel@acmeiq.com) will want the SOC2 / data flow diagram ahead of time.

Windows: 11/23 is tight for Samir (on rotation) but 11/29 09:30 PT looks good for our core team. We also have a 12/1 morning slot if needed.

Can Ben include a short slide on network egress controls and KV caching behavior? Samir specifically asked about data residency and audit logs.

-Erin

Erin/Ava —

Thanks for the context. I can take the technical walkthrough. A couple internal constraints to flag so we pick the right slot:
- I'm traveling 11/23 (red-eye that morning) and prefer to avoid after-hours demos.
- 11/29 09:30 PT works for me. If we need an alternative, I can also do 12/01 10:00 PT.

On the content side I’ll include:
- Network egress & VPC peering options (10 min)
- KV cache and prefix caching behavior (5–7 min)
- Audit logs, retention controls, and recommended logging hooks for SIEM (10 min)

I’ll attach a short SPIKE doc and a sanitized data-flow diagram for Samir to review prior to the call (SOC2 snapshot attached).

ben.carter@redwood.com | (650) 555-0231

Thanks all — locking in 11/29 09:30–10:45 PT for the session. Calendar invite + ICS attached.

Tentative agenda (60–75 min):
1) 0–40 min: SE technical walkthrough (Ben) — architecture, performance, KV cache behavior
2) 40–60 min: Security deep-dive (Ben + Dylan) — audit logs, data residency, requested controls
3) 60–75 min: Procurement + next steps (Ava + procurement) — PO timeline, trial/dev access

Pre-reads attached: SOC2 snapshot + procurement checklist. Samir — if you want a quick 15-min pre-call tomorrow to run through the data-flow, Ben can do 11/23 after 1 pm PT (he has a travel block in the morning).

Next steps:
- Erin/procurement to confirm 11/29 attendees and whether Samir will join the main call or prefers a short pre-brief.
- I’ll update the HubSpot deal with the scheduled meeting and add the attachments.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Ava Chen
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
